verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a local CLI and library image processor that works on files the user supplies. It hosts no production data or environments, so a separate sandbox or test environment is a category error for this kind of product. Its security policies (Open/Limited/Secure/Websafe) restrict which coders and resources it may use. That is an adjacent execution-hardening control, not a sandbox for testing apart from production, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
